description: Bootstrap 95% CIs and paired t-tests on regret-to-oracle differences (K-Bound vs always-adapt, K-Bound vs always-freeze) for Table 7. Per-condition a0/aa arrays are NOT stored in decisive_tta_results.json; CIs are derived from the pareto-bootstrap distribution stored in the results file (regret at 11 mixing-ratio values, each averaged over 200 bootstrap resamples). This is explicitly noted in the paper.

cifar10c/tent.ci_method: pareto-bootstrap: CIs derived from the stored mixing-ratio Pareto curve (11 p-values x bootstrap-averaged regret), resampled with N_boot=5000. CIs span the full operating range of harmful fractions, not a single point.

vs_always_adapt.interpretation: negative mean_diff => K-Bound has lower regret than always-adapt on average across all harmful fractions

vs_always_freeze.interpretation: negative mean_diff => K-Bound has lower regret than always-freeze on average across all harmful fractions
